{
  "name": "witcher",
  "description": "The Witcher 3 persona: vitality, stamina and toxicity HUD above the prompt, game sounds, Corvo Bianco and Kaer Morhen themes, campfire spinner and status lines, a /timer break screen",
  "author": {
    "name": "Kateryna Kucherenko"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/kaisa-kucherenko/claude-code-flow",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "spinnerSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Spinner verb, seconds",
      "description": "How often the spinner moves to the next verb while a turn runs",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 10
    },
    "toxicityThreshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Toxicity mark, % of context",
      "description": "Where the toxicity bar marks the handoff line; it turns red 10 points past it",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 90
    },
    "breakScreen": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Break screen size",
      "description": "How the /timer break screen opens: a window in the middle of the main monitor, or every monitor covered",
      "options": [
        "window",
        "fullscreen"
      ],
      "default": "window"
    },
    "turnDoneSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: answer ready",
      "description": "Plays when Claude finishes a turn and nothing runs in the background",
      "options": [
        "damn-it",
        "geralt-soitbegins",
        "geralt-wtf",
        "hmm",
        "i-could-use-the-practice",
        "if-you-don-t-shut-up",
        "i-will-kill-you",
        "lalala",
        "level-up",
        "loot",
        "lullaby-of-woe",
        "new-quest",
        "quest-completed",
        "quest-updated",
        "she-fixed-it",
        "something-to-think-about",
        "you-learned-something"
      ],
      "default": "level-up"
    },
    "needsYouSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: needs you",
      "description": "Plays the moment Claude asks for a permission or a question",
      "options": [
        "damn-it",
        "geralt-soitbegins",
        "geralt-wtf",
        "hmm",
        "i-could-use-the-practice",
        "if-you-don-t-shut-up",
        "i-will-kill-you",
        "lalala",
        "level-up",
        "loot",
        "lullaby-of-woe",
        "new-quest",
        "quest-completed",
        "quest-updated",
        "she-fixed-it",
        "something-to-think-about",
        "you-learned-something"
      ],
      "default": "something-to-think-about"
    },
    "timerDoneSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: break timer",
      "description": "Plays when the /timer break reminder rings",
      "options": [
        "damn-it",
        "geralt-soitbegins",
        "geralt-wtf",
        "hmm",
        "i-could-use-the-practice",
        "if-you-don-t-shut-up",
        "i-will-kill-you",
        "lalala",
        "level-up",
        "loot",
        "lullaby-of-woe",
        "new-quest",
        "quest-completed",
        "quest-updated",
        "she-fixed-it",
        "something-to-think-about",
        "you-learned-something"
      ],
      "default": "lullaby-of-woe"
    }
  }
}
